## Code Review

This pull request implements an offline, additive repair of the completed 34-question VLM candidate set for issue #1616. It introduces a repair script and corresponding unit tests, adds output artifacts and a markdown report, and updates the provider retry logic to handle HTTP 308 redirects and validate response shapes. The review feedback suggests enhancing validation robustness by explicitly checking for null, empty, non-string, or duplicate keys when mapping question and attempt IDs, as well as catching operational failures in the main entry point to emit stable JSON diagnostics to stderr.
